subject: Music Production
title: Stock Aitken Waterman's Hit Factory
description: One-minute skill: Stock Aitken Waterman's Hit Factory.

hook.text: In 1980s London, Mike Stock, Matt Aitken, and Pete Waterman built a pop production assembly line.

buildup.text: They wrote, produced, and mixed songs at astonishing pace, sometimes finishing a track in a day.

discovery.text: Their Hi-NRG pop formula produced over a hundred UK Top 40 hits in just five years.

twist.text: Critics dismissed their music as manufactured, but audiences kept buying millions of copies.

climax.text: SAW defined 1980s pop and proved systematic production could dominate an entire decade of charts.

punchline.text: An assembly line for pop songs conquered the charts.

quiz.question: How quickly could Stock Aitken Waterman finish a song?
